hero.title: Hallimane: Bangalore's Authentic Village Dining Experience
hero.subtitle: Savor the rich flavors of rural India, served with legacy and love for over 20 years at Hallimane.

about.title: Our Hallimane Story: A Taste of Tradition
about.paragraph1: Hallimane has been a landmark in the culinary map of Bangalore for well over 20 years. Located in a vintage part of Bangalore, the restaurant features a distinct village ambience with its tiled roofs, natural brick walls, high ceilings and an abundance of plants; Hallimane has been proclaimed as one of the best ethnic and value for money restaurants in Bangalore by the media.
about.paragraph2: Hallimane is truly a destination for most Bangaloreans and visitors who prefer to savor the best of rural cuisine in an authentic rural setting. We are dedicated to serving fresh, hygienic and delicious rural food, complemented by exemplary service, ensuring every dining experience with us is memorable and steeped in tradition.
